settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage OneDrive access, local data, and account-scoped receipt AI settings.

safety.heading: Protect your data
safety.warning: Close the desktop app before using Conspectus Mobile. Never use both apps at the same time.
safety.explanation: Both apps use the same database file. Changes made at the same time can overwrite each other.
safety.recoveryDescription: Personal OneDrive accounts keep file version history for 30 days. If a change was accidental or incorrect, open the database file on OneDrive.com, choose Version history, and restore the version you need.

openRouter.heading: Receipt AI with OpenRouter
openRouter.description: Use your own OpenRouter key and choose separate live models for receipt reading and transfer creation.

privacy.heading: Privacy and changing availability
privacy.localKey: Your API key is stored only in this browser for the active Microsoft account. A browser-stored key is accessible to anyone or any malicious script with access to this browser profile; it is not protected like a server-held secret.
privacy.stageOne: Stage 1 sends the receipt image to OpenRouter and a routed vision provider.
privacy.stageTwo: Stage 2 sends only the extracted receipt data to OpenRouter and a routed text provider; it does not send the image again.
privacy.providerPolicies: OpenRouter and routed-provider logging, retention, and training policies vary. Free models can disappear or become paid at any time.
privacy.routing: Conspectus does not force Zero Data Retention or no-data-collection routing. Stricter privacy settings and guardrails configured in your OpenRouter account still apply.
privacy.catalogOnly: Saving these settings or loading the catalog sends no receipt, extraction result, Conspectus database, accounts, categories, balances, or transfer history.
